CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE password_reset_token ( user_id INT NOT NULL, token_hash CHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, exchanged_at DATETIME NULL, consumed_at DATETIME NULL )
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE email_change_token LIKE password_reset_token
